IS 14715 : Part 2 : 2016 : Jute Geotextiles Part 2 Control of Bank Erosion in Rivers and Waterways - Specification ( Second Revision )ICS 59.080.70TXD 30Reaffirmed 20201. ScopeThis standard (Part 2) provides requirements of woven jute geotextile (JGT) in control of erosion in rivers and waterways.2. ReferencesThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards aresubject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
